As his pancreas are effected , to decrease the exocrine secretion of pancreas they have given octreotide inj. projectile , non bilious.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"background-color: #d9d2e9;\"\u003EApprisal\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EHistory was taken well.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EGood lab work clear evaluation was done\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"background-color: #d9d2e9;\"\u003ENegative points\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThere are no clinical pics of the symptoms like pedal edema.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EProper chronological order of symptoms apperance was not done\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EFever chart was not included.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENo IO charting was done though it was told it should be strictly monitoredit would have been better if urine was sent for eosinophils for interatial disease\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"background-color: #d9d2e9;\"\u003EMy Analysis\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThis is\u0026nbsp; case of CKD ?\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp;Chronic interstitial nephritis secondary to plasma cell dyscariasis, (multiple myeloma -
